name: Bunkr Solution
author: yfel

sections.description:
Bunkr Solution provides enterprise-grade bot protection for your WordPress site through sophisticated server-side analysis.

Key Features:
* Real-time behavioral analysis
* Advanced bot detection
* Seamless user experience for legitimate visitors
* Enterprise-grade protection
* Easy integration with WordPress

External Services

This plugin connects to the Bunkr API service to analyze website traffic and provide bot protection. Here’s what you need to know:

Service Information

  • Service: Bunkr Bot Protection API (https://wpde.bunkr-solution.com)
  • Purpose: Real-time analysis of website requests to identify and block malicious bot traffic
  • Provider: Bunkr Solution (https://bunkr-solution.com)

Data Transmission

When data is sent: Every time a non-admin user visits your website (excluding AJAX requests)

What data is sent:
* Request metadata: URL, HTTP method, referrer, timestamp
* Server headers: User-Agent, Accept headers, security headers (Sec-* headers)
* Network information: IP address, domain name
* Browser context: Mobile detection, HTTPS status
* Cookie analysis: Count and types of cookies (WordPress, session, persistent)
* Request identifier: Unique request identifier

No sensitive data: The plugin does not send form data, post content, user credentials, or personal information.

Legal Information

  • Terms of Service: https://bunkr-solution.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://bunkr-solution.com/privacy

User Consent

By installing and activating this plugin, you acknowledge that:
1. Request data will be sent to Bunkr’s servers for analysis
2. This data transmission is necessary for the plugin’s bot protection functionality
3. You have reviewed Bunkr’s terms of service and privacy policy
4. You are responsible for informing your website users about this data processing if required by applicable privacy laws
sections.installation:
From WordPress Admin

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Bunkr Solution”
  3. Install and activate the plugin
  4. Go to Settings > Bunkr Protection
  5. Enter your API key from your Bunkr dashboard

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and install
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Configure your API key in Settings > Bunkr Protection

Getting Your API Key

  1. Visit Bunkr Dashboard
  2. Create a free account or log in
  3. Generate your WordPress API key
  4. Copy the key to your WordPress plugin settings
